contract: Bounded selected-provider availability and typed model catalog observations reuse existing image/video registries and local management registry. Durable sanitized SQLite observation is cached separately from explicit refresh. Status distinguishes missing selection/provider/model/download and availability errors; configured never claims inference, valid credentials, remote reachability or GPU capacity. Existing settings remain authoritative for model install and selection. HTTP/tools/UI consume same observation.
acceptance: Real provider adapter configuration/catalog checks without external generation, actual typed image/video catalog metadata, SQLite reopen/update, real empty-registry subprocess refresh, HTTP/tool scope validation and UI rendering with stale/inference boundaries. No fake provider or GPU result. External configured provider inference requires future operator qualification.
remaining_limits: Availability semantics are provider-defined; all responses explicitly leave inference_verified false
Remote inference, GPU fitness, model installation and live browser are not qualified by this task
Hosted uses a separately bound captured-grant observation adapter instead of global registries
